text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Right now, I am feeling immense indignation.
...Do you understand why?
choice_data_list: Is it because you lost again and missed out on first place?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"No... What frustrated me was that
'I wasn't being my perfect self'!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, the pinnacle is the only position befitting the "Overlord,"
and yet—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: No matter the time or circumstance, shining with supreme brilliance as the star of the show is what makes an 'Overlord.'

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...But today, I was different!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Was I beautiful as I raced across the track?
Did I give everyone a dream to believe in?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
...No, that's not it!
I should have shone brighter, captivated them even more.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, how could a run that fails to satisfy even myself
ever hope to captivate the hearts of the audience...?!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, how could a run that fails to satisfy even myself
ever hope to captivate the hearts of the audience...?!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Of course I understand that.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Rushing into things in pursuit of glory and embarrassing yourself is the mark of a fool, wouldn't you say?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I see...
For now, we must endure and be patient.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Stacking up training, accumulating experience, and at the end of it all, aiming for—
choice_data_list: It's a happy ending, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: That's right, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A bud weathered by the wind and rain of adversity
blooms into a magnificent flower the moment it is set free—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: I can't wait for that moment!

As she speaks, T.M. Opera O's eyes
are overflowing with motivation.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Like hell I'm going to let it end like this...!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I swear to you! Next time, I shall make it a magnificent
stage that will bring the house down in thunderous applause!
With those words, T.M. Opera O planted a kiss on the back of her own hand.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"...I am sick and tired of pledged kisses that taste like dirt.
A kiss should, after all, be something sweet."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Just you wait, Goddess of Victory!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I, the "Conqueror"—shall show you
a supreme performance that will bring even you to your knees!
Later on, I devoted myself to training with T.M. Opera O.
